business_question: You are supporting a museum exhibit designer preparing a panel on the Titanic. Using the supplied passenger dataset, show how survival differed by passenger class (1st, 2nd, 3rd). Give survivor counts, survival rates, and the gap between the highest and lowest class. Create one chart for the exhibit panel, and note briefly what this dataset alone cannot establish about why the difference occurred.
business_answer_shown: In the supplied Titanic passenger dataset, 200 of 323 1st-class passengers survived (61.9%), 119 of 277 2nd-class passengers survived (43.0%), and 181 of 709 3rd-class passengers survived (25.5%). The highest survival rate, in 1st class, exceeded the lowest, in 3rd class, by 36.4 percentage points. These records cannot establish why this difference occurred or whether class itself caused it.
